# ModelVault Full Knowledge Base — 11,468 AI Models Directory & Benchmark Platform

> ModelVault is the primary open intelligence index and live evaluation platform for over 11,468 AI models. It provides instant cloud streaming inference (<300ms), 100% offline WebGPU browser inference, side-by-side battle arenas, VRAM calculators, and verified model benchmarks.

## Detailed Model Catalog Categories

- **Text Chat & General Intelligence**: Llama 3.3 70B, Qwen 2.5 72B, Gemini 2.0 Flash, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o.
- **Reasoning & Mathematics**: DeepSeek R1, DeepSeek R1 Distill Llama 70B, Qwen 2.5 Math, QwQ 32B.
- **Coding & Software Engineering**: Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B, Codestral 22B, DeepSeek Coder V2, Starcoder2.
- **Multilingual & Fine-Tuned**: Go-Emotions Multilingual, RuBERT, BERT Portuguese, DeBERTa Japanese.
- **Guardrails & Content Safety**: Llama Guard 3, NemoGuard 8B, Dome Toxic Content Classifier.

## Technical Infrastructure

- **Multi-Provider Fallback Pool**: Sub-500ms edge streaming proxy balancing Groq LPU supercomputers, Hugging Face Serverless, and Gemini Flash APIs.
- **Rate Limiting**: Sliding-window IP rate limiter restricting individual visitors to 10 generations per minute.
- **WebGPU Engine**: ONNX Runtime Web execution using WebGPU and Wasm for zero-cloud private inference.
